dash.card.invoicesDesc: Create and manage invoices & change orders
invoice.noDocumentsHint: Try adjusting your filters or create a new invoice.
invoice.create.subtitle: Fill in the details below to create a new document
invoice.refDataError: We couldn't load clients and projects. The dropdowns below may be empty.
invoice.validation.requiredFields: Please fill client and project fields
invoice.validation.dueDateAfter: Due date must be on or after issue date
invoice.validation.addItem: Add at least one line item with a price
invoice.create.successHint: The document has been added to Accounts Receivable.
invoice.create.corSuccessHint: The request is now in Pending Approval. It will not appear in Accounts Receivable as billable until an admin confirms the client's sign-off.
invoice.create.corNextStep: Tip: switch to Accounts Receivable to see the pending-approval queue and approve it.
invoice.dialog.corPendingNote: Change order requests are saved as Pending Approval. They appear in Accounts Receivable only after an admin records the client's approval there.
invoice.list.paymentsElsewhere: Recording a payment and approving a change order do not happen here: that lives in Accounts Receivable, and each row's menu jumps straight there.
invoice.list.hiddenCors: Change orders awaiting approval do not appear in this list unless you filter by that status: the server leaves them out of any query with no status filter.
invoice.list.noPermission: Your account cannot see billing documents.
invoice.list.errorTitle: We could not fetch your documents.
invoice.list.errorHint: Nothing is lost: what you issued is still on the server. Check your connection and try again.
invoice.list.emptyTitle: You have not issued anything yet.
invoice.list.emptyHint: An invoice bills what the jobsite's contract agreed. A change order asks for money outside that contract, and starts out awaiting approval.
invoice.list.noMatchHint: Try widening the date range or dropping the jobsite filter.
invoice.figure.failed: The summary did not load. The three figures stay at “—”: they are never filled in by adding up the page.
invoice.picker.failed: We could not search. Try again.
invoice.window.title: Issue document
invoice.window.numberedOnSave: The system assigns the number on save · one sequence per company and year
invoice.window.invoiceTagline: Bills what was agreed · starts out pending payment
invoice.window.corTagline: Asks for money outside the contract · starts out awaiting approval
invoice.window.corNotice: This change order starts out awaiting approval and is not billable. Once the client approves it, an admin confirms that in Accounts Receivable: there it becomes billable and raises the jobsite's billable ceiling.
invoice.window.noLetterhead: Your documents currently go out with no header: no letterhead is configured.
invoice.window.numberHint: Leave it blank and the system numbers it. You can write your own; a repeat is rejected.
invoice.window.dueCor: A change order has no due date: it falls due when it is approved and becomes a charge.
invoice.window.clientPh: Search by name, contact or email…
invoice.window.clientHint: Searched on the server, not among the first 50.
invoice.window.clientOther: Type a client that is not on the list
invoice.window.projectHint: Billable jobsites only: neither closed nor missing a client or cost code.
invoice.window.projectEmpty: No billable jobsite by that name.
invoice.window.corReasonPh: e.g. Additional retaining wall, not in the drawings
invoice.window.corReasonHint: It is printed on the document: a change order with no reason cannot be defended to the client.
invoice.window.linesHint: Quantity and price as figures. A 0 stays 0 and is flagged on its row; it is never turned into a 1 in silence.
invoice.window.footerHint: On issue: it is saved, the PDF downloads with its number, and the row appears in the list.
invoice.ceiling.label: Left to bill on {{project}}
invoice.ceiling.fullLabel: This jobsite is billed in full
invoice.ceiling.roomBody: Billing does not draw down the jobsite's budget: it is only compared against this ceiling. Go over it and the server rejects the document.
invoice.ceiling.tightBody: There is very little room left. Anything above the ceiling is rejected by the server; if the work went past the contract, issue a change order.
invoice.ceiling.noneBody: No further invoice fits against this contract. Billing extra work needs an approved change order, which raises the ceiling.
invoice.ceiling.exempt: A change order is exempt from the ceiling: it exists precisely to ask for more. The amount is compared against nothing at creation, and the ceiling rises when it is approved.
invoice.ceiling.unknownLabel: This jobsite has no contract on record
invoice.ceiling.unknownBody: With no original contract we cannot tell you what is left to bill. You can still issue; the server compares against no ceiling.
invoice.validation.quantity: The quantity has to be greater than zero.
invoice.validation.discountTooBig: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal. At most, {{max}}.
invoice.validation.overCeiling: That is {{over}} over the jobsite's ceiling. {{remaining}} is left to bill against its contract.
invoice.validation.corReason: Write the reason for the change.
invoice.error.PROJECT_CLOSED: This jobsite is closed: its budget and scope are final, and it takes no new documents.
invoice.error.PROJECT_INCOMPLETE_FOR_ACC: This jobsite is missing its client or its cost code, so accounting cannot take its invoice. Complete it in Projects.
invoice.error.INVALID_DISCOUNT: The discount cannot exceed the subtotal.
invoice.error.DUPLICATE_INVOICE_NUMBER: A document with this number already exists. Leave it blank and the system numbers it.
invoice.error.EXCEEDS_CONTRACT: The amount goes over the jobsite's billable ceiling. Lower the total or issue a change order.
invoice.error.INVALID_AMOUNT: The total has to be greater than zero.
invoice.error.MISSING_AMOUNT: Add at least one line item with a price.
invoice.error.INVALID_DATES: The due date must be on or after the issue date.
invoice.error.unknown: We could not issue the document. Nothing was saved and what you typed is still here.
invoice.preview.live: Live document · redrawn as you type
invoice.preview.note: Drawn in your browser as you type. The final PDF downloads when you issue it, with your letterhead and in the panel's language.
invoice.preview.title: Preview
invoice.preview.empty: Add a line item with a description or price to see the document preview.
